context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug from iteration_365 (wrong current password on /settings redirecting to /login) is fixed and verified. Auth uses httpOnly cookies primarily; localStorage-based invalid-token simulation is not reliable to test the global 401 redirect for non-auth endpoints. If future testing needs to verify the global session-expired redirect still fires for non-auth 401s, trigger it by invalidating server-side session (e.g., cookie tampering) rather than injecting localStorage token.
